premises.text: People have less time while social feeds grow noisier, burying cared-about content
premises.evidence_span: We have less and less time to consume more and more information

premises.text: Undrip takes only the sharing/curating slice of social behavior into its own noise-free community
premises.evidence_span: we're taking a slice of the existing behavior that happens on traditional social networks, that is sharing and curating really cool pieces of content from around the web, and we're building our own community with it

premises.text: Connects existing social graphs/content and ranks with social context, habits, and popularity for relevance plus surprise
premises.evidence_span: We leverage your existing social graph, your existing social content. We're optimizing for relevance, but we're open and happy to see serendipity

premises.text: Tastemaker following and drip-reshare make discovery community-driven
premises.evidence_span: What we care most about is who shared the content, not what's behind the content

premises.text: Primarily a mobile App Store product (iPhone/iPad; Android soon)
premises.evidence_span: We're on the iPhone. We're on the iPad. We're in the App Store. Go download us today. Android is coming very soon

value.text: Noise-free discovery and sharing of the most interesting web content
value.evidence_span: sharing and discovering the most interesting and compelling content from around the web, noise-free

notes: Implicit-interest and friend-thumbnail details folded into ranking/social-context premise.
